decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the product list for actual backpacks, excluding accessories like lanterns, towels, and carabiners. My consideration set includes a variety of sizes and styles: a large 70L frame pack (High Sierra), a mid-sized 40L daypack (SHENHU), a compact 20L foldable pack (vimapo), and two tactical-style options (G4Free and Seibertron). I ultimately chose the SHENHU 40L (prod_backpacks_111) as it offers the best balance of features, capacity, and price. At $26.99, it is highly rated (4.5 stars) and reviews highlight its durability and comfortable support system for hiking, making it a better value proposition than the more expensive Seibertron ($59.99) or the fit-problematic High Sierra ($109.99).
